biography.plain_text: Lyndal Garner is an American businessman who founded Garner Environmental Services in Houston. He built a company providing emergency response, industrial maintenance, waste disposal and safety training. After more than three decades as its president, he retired when K-Solv acquired the business, combining its disaster-response capabilities with chemical distribution and maritime services.

long_biography.plain_text:
At Garner Environmental Services, Lyndal Garner made a deliberate choice about the lawyer he wanted on his team. He kept the general counsel position open for Bobbie Risner while she completed her family-law commitments. They also shared an interest in military history, giving them a connection beyond the immediate demands of the business.

During his leadership, the company took on work that required crews to mobilise quickly and remain deployed for extended periods. Following the World Trade Center attacks, it helped process debris at Staten Island's landfill alongside police and federal investigators. The operation lasted ten months and involved sifting material removed from the site.
